## Problem and purpose
What user or learning problem does this solve?

## Changes
What behavior changes? Note affected lessons, scenarios, progress schemas, or APIs.

## Learning and evidence
- What should the learner understand or do independently?
- Does this include predicted, illustrative, learner-reported, or executed results?
- For Solidity: source revision, compiler/EVM settings, command, assertions and actual result.

## Verification
List exact commands and observed outcomes. Separate Node, Solidity and browser checks. Mark skipped/blocked checks with the reason; do not mark them passed.

## Coordination and risks
Related branches/PRs; changes to stored notes; dependencies or source attribution; remaining limitations.

## Review checklist
- [ ] Existing learner work is preserved.
- [ ] No secrets or private learner notes included.
- [ ] Completion and mastery are distinguished.
- [ ] Expected outcomes and observed evidence are distinguished.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and source notices updated.
- [ ] Required follow-up checks are visible above.
